verdict.reason: The curator explicitly names 121 source-native placement trials, the single-release record and all three archives have immutable identity and consistent CC-BY-4.0 registry rights, and the physical robot execution modality is distinct at metadata level. Outcome-label isolation, external split rejection, trial manifest identity, privacy, nested notice, lineage, pointer, security relevance, and LLM increment remain open.
